prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Atlanta for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: Look for American Board of Orthodontics
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There isn’t a single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right doctor depends on your location in Atlanta, age (child vs adult), treatment goals (traditional braces vs Invisalign), insurance, budget, and personal preferences. I can help you find the best provider for your situation if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is for a child or an adult.

How to find the best orthodontist in Atlanta (quick steps)
1. Narrow your priorities
   - Invisalign or metal/ceramic braces?
   - Convenience (near work/home), cost/insurance, evening/weekend hours?
   - Importance of digital tech (iTero scanner, 3D imaging), experience with complex cases?

2. Check credentials and experience
   - Make sure the provider is an orthodontist (completed an orthodontic residency). Dentists who offer braces/aligners are not the same as orthodontists.
   - Look for American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) certification — it’s a higher-level credential but not every excellent orthodontist is board certified.
   - For Invisalign specifically, check the provider’s Invisalign status (Gold/Platinum/Diamond indicates higher case volume, which often correlates with experience).

3. Use reliable search tools
   - AAO (American Association of Orthodontists) “Find an Orthodontist”
   - Invisalign provider locator
   - Google Maps, Yelp, and Healthgrades for patient reviews and before/after photos

4. Compare care, tech, and cost
   - Ask about digital scanning (no goopy impressions), treatment planning software, and whether they use temporary anchorage devices (TADs) or CBCT when needed.
   - Get written estimates that include retainers and follow-up visits.
   - Ask about payment plans and whether they accept your insurance.

5. Evaluate in-person (or virtual) consultations
   - Go to at least two consults. Good questions to ask are below.
   - Review before/after photos of similar cases.
   - Note how the staff treats you, how clearly they explain options, and whether they give a clear timeline.

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Are you an orthodontist by specialty? Where did you train?
- Are you ABO certified?
- How many Invisalign (or braces) cases do you do per year? What’s your Invisalign status?
- Can I see before/after photos of patients with similar issues?
- What is the estimated treatment time and total cost? What’s included?
- Do you use digital scans? How often are visits required?
- What happens if I break a bracket or lose an aligner?
- Who does emergencies after hours?

If you want, I can:
- Suggest a short list of highly reviewed orthodontists near you if you tell me your Atlanta ZIP code and whether this is for an adult or child.
- Draft a short message/email you can send to offices asking the right questions.

Which would you like to do next?
